# claude-code-kit

> A library of skills, mods, subagents, hooks, slash commands and guides for Claude Code. Agents installing parts of it for a user should follow INSTALL.md: inspect the environment, propose a selection, install from the latest release tag without overwriting user files, then verify.

Start with [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/INSTALL.md). Raw files: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/<tag>/<path>`. Releases: https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/releases

## Install

- [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/INSTALL.md): agent runbook — bundles, skill dependencies, install steps per component type, verification, updates
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): what changed between tags

## Installable components

- [Skills](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/tree/master/01-global-optimization/skills): 18 skills → `~/.claude/skills/<name>/` (agent-ready, agent-team, cache-inspector, code-research, codebase-memory, company, confidence-check, continuity, ctx, decision-classify, init-project, optimize, self-improve, sprint-orchestrate, sync-features, ui-ux-review, update-docs, video-digest)
- [Mods marketplace](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/tree/master/17-mods/marketplace): `ai-prompts-mods`, 13 Claude Code mods (≥ 2.1.287) with tests
- [Subagents](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/tree/master/10-subagents/examples): 8 agent definitions → `~/.claude/agents/`
- [Security hooks](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/tree/master/13-security-hardening/hooks): PreToolUse guards with tests
- [Productivity hooks](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/tree/master/01-global-optimization/hooks): shell-habits, package-version check, memory load
- [Slash commands](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/tree/master/07-custom-commands): debug, deploy, i18n, perf, qa, refactor, retro, seo, content-review
- [Global rules](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/tree/master/01-global-optimization/system-prompts): sections to merge into `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`

## Guides

- [01 Global optimization](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/01-global-optimization/guide.md): one-time `~/.claude/` setup
- [02 Project activation](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/02-project-activation/guide.md): per-project Serena memories
- [03 Custom skills](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/03-custom-skills/guide.md): writing skills
- [05 Token optimization](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/05-token-optimization/guide.md)
- [06 Advanced patterns](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/tree/master/06-advanced-patterns): multi-agent, Agent Teams, sprint orchestration
- [10 Subagents](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/10-subagents/guide.md)
- [13 Security hardening](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/13-security-hardening/guide.md)
- [16 Autonomous agents](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/16-autonomous-agents/guide.md): unattended runs, heartbeat
- [17 Mods](https://github.com/escapeboy/claude-code-kit/blob/master/17-mods/guide.md)
